# Abdullah Alhar

> Abdullah Alhar (also written Abdullah Bin Alhar) is a 2nd year BSc in Information Technology student at SLIIT (Sri Lanka Institute of Information Technology) in Sri Lanka, specialising in Artificial Intelligence. Abdullah builds web apps with Spring Boot and React, mobile apps with Flutter, and machine learning projects with Python, works as a freelance full-stack developer, and is looking for internships.

- Studying: BSc in Information Technology Specialising in Artificial Intelligence, SLIIT (2025 - present). Dean's List, Year 1 Semester 1.
- Before university: Harvard CS50x (Introduction to Computer Science) and CS50P (Introduction to Programming with Python), online, 2024.
- IEEE Student Member (IEEE Sri Lanka Section, 2026).
- Winner: Code Night N3:GO Excellence Award, SLIIT Mozilla Campus Club (Aug 2026).
- Languages spoken: English, Tamil, Sinhala.
- Location: Sri Lanka.

## Skills

- Languages: Java, Python, JavaScript, Dart, C
- Frameworks: Spring Boot, React, Flutter, Thymeleaf
- AI and machine learning: Jupyter, Google Colab, TensorFlow, Keras, scikit-learn
- Tools and platforms: Firebase, MySQL, Arduino, Git, GitHub, Railway

## Projects

- [SmartNest Apartment Sales System](https://github.com/abdullah-alhar/smartnest-apartment-system): a full-stack web app built with React and Spring Boot that moves an apartment sales company online, from customer inquiry to reservation.
- [Malaria Cell Image Classifier](https://github.com/abdullah-alhar/malaria-cell-classification): a CNN built from scratch with TensorFlow and Keras that classifies blood cell images as infected or healthy, with 94.2% test accuracy (0.975 ROC-AUC).
- [Student Course Registration System](https://github.com/abdullah-alhar/student-registration): a full-stack MVC web app built with Java, Spring Boot and Thymeleaf for a university OOP module.

## Common questions

### Who is Abdullah Alhar?

Abdullah Alhar is a 2nd year BSc in Information Technology student at SLIIT (Sri Lanka Institute of Information Technology) in Sri Lanka, specialising in Artificial Intelligence. Abdullah builds web apps, mobile apps and machine learning projects, and is an IEEE Student Member.

### What does Abdullah Alhar study?

Abdullah Alhar is studying for a BSc in Information Technology specialising in Artificial Intelligence at SLIIT, started in 2025, and made the Dean's List in Year 1 Semester 1. Before university, Abdullah completed Harvard's CS50x and CS50P courses online in 2024.

### What projects has Abdullah Alhar built?

Abdullah Alhar's projects include SmartNest, an apartment sales web app built with React and Spring Boot; a Malaria Cell Image Classifier, a CNN built with TensorFlow and Keras that reached 94.2% test accuracy; and a Student Course Registration System built with Java, Spring Boot and Thymeleaf.

### What programming languages and tools does Abdullah Alhar use?

Abdullah Alhar works with Java, Python, JavaScript, Dart and C, using Spring Boot and React for web apps, Flutter for mobile apps, and TensorFlow, Keras and scikit-learn for machine learning. Other tools include Firebase, MySQL, Git and GitHub.

### Is Abdullah Alhar open to internships?

Yes. Abdullah Alhar is looking for internships to work on real projects and learn more, and is also open to interesting projects.

### Does Abdullah Alhar do freelance work?

Yes. Abdullah Alhar works as a freelance full-stack developer alongside his degree, building business software such as POS and inventory systems, web apps and AI-powered automations.
